seoTitle: UTM Channel Matrix Generator: Many URLs, Many Channels, CSV
metaDescription: Tag many URLs across many channels with UTM parameters in one go and copy the table as CSV. Free, private, runs in your browser.
intro: Paste URLs and channels and get every combination tagged, as CSV rows.
why:
Tagging each link for each channel by hand invites typos, and one wrong capital splits your reports. A matrix keeps source, medium and campaign names consistent.

Each channel line holds source, medium and optional campaign and content, separated by pipes. Values can be lowercased and spaces replaced with underscores. Existing query strings and fragments are kept.
howTo: List channels as source | medium | campaign | content.
Set the default campaign and cleaning options.
Copy the CSV into a spreadsheet.

faq.a: Analytics tools treat Email and email as different values.

faq.q: Can a channel have its own campaign?
faq.a: Yes, put it as the third field.
